eligible_candidates: Epochs1..20 from completed full1M zero and warm runs, correct H128/residual1 and changed quantized parameters versus shipped network. Initial checkpoints are baselines, not newtrainednets.
ranking: minimum complete originalvalidation pure-teacher MSE; exactties prefer zero thenwarm thenearlier epoch
freeze: Save chosen exportSHA/parameter-delta/checkpoint/manifest identity before any independent-audit model evaluation. No model selection or retraining from independentaudit results.
acceptance: Newtrainednet must pass actualC++ parity and report comparison against HCE. Comparison against shippednet is separate; do not replace a better shippednet or claim Elo. Negative audit does not permit choosing another candidate on that audit.
failure_policy: If no full-data trained export qualifies, report failure; do not substitute an unplanned pilot winner to claim a full-data result.
strength_gate: User crew owns subsequent1000game QA; no playingstrength claim here.
